findings.trigger: Persist valid media Quote {entitlement:spark,currency:USD,estimateMinMinor:10,estimateMaxMinor:20}, actual snapshot billingMode tokens; immutable companion BudgetQuote {entitlement:subscription,currency:USD,estimateMin:0,estimateMax:0}. findings.observed: Real SQLite accepts both persisted quotes; prepareBudgetContext succeeds; reserveInTransaction creates zero reservation instead of rejecting. Reviewer guard expecting throw fails exit1. This source is identical at both reviewed SHAs.
findings.impact: Actual token-mode request can cross budget boundary using zero liability and wrong allowed entitlement. B4 checking the live media quote does not repair a mismatched finance companion.
findings.required_fix: Check compatibility in preparation and inside final reserve, including replay pin validation. Root exact rule: minor_currency companion entitlement/currency/estimateMin/estimateMax equal media entitlement/currency/estimateMinMinor/estimateMaxMinor; budget expiry must not exceed media expiry. Snapshot billingMode subscription for subscription entitlement and tokens for spark; unknown blocks. Spark-token scope uses separate amounts and requires legacy media currency/estimateMinMinor/estimateMaxMinor null; no conversion or pretend token pricing proof. Denial before registerBudgetExecution/reservation insert.
findings.required_evidence: Behavioral RED/GREEN real SQLite conflicting entitlement/mode, minor currency mismatch and amount mismatch/extended expiry. Assert no execution/reservation/ledger rows; positive matching anchor and take still reserve.
